reform: LO 2/2024 amends LOREG 44bis and 187(2) with alternate-sex candidate lists for covered elections; applies to elections called after law effective date
prior: LO 3/2007 BOE-A-2007-6115 already required 40/60 candidate sex composition with conditions; not baseline 'no regulation'

municipal_population_bands.requirement: Article 44bis alternation is not required under art 187(2) exception
municipal_population_bands.precise_treatment: may have other preexisting/general election requirements; do not assert no law at all

municipal_population_bands.requirement: 40/60 sex composition on municipal candidacy; alternation under 44bis not required
municipal_population_bands.precise_treatment: lower bound >3000 inferred from overriding explicit <=3000 case
not claim realised compliance without actual candidates

outcomes: Mayor selection is not directly candidate-list parity. INE mayor vs councillor 2025 occupancy cannot be causally attributed to this reform absent post-treatment election, official population per municipal constituency and confounder controls.
design_candidate: RD/event-study only for future called elections and carefully defined population thresholds; examine manipulation/size, migration and election timing; no claim RD executed
additional_2025_jec: BOE-A-2025-22665 Instrucción 3/2025 clarifies 44bis and 187(2) exceptions, but is a separate later interpretive text, not identical legal enactment.
